summary: W. P. Carey Inc. filed an 8-K on June 17, 2026, disclosing that its tenant Hellweg Die Profi-Bauärkte GmbH & Co. KG filed for insolvency under self-administration on June 16, 2026. W. P. Carey net-leases 16 properties to Hellweg generating ~$15.2M annualized base rent. The tenant paid rent through May 2026; bank guarantees cover three months of rent. W. P. Carey has binding agreements to re-lease eight stores at comparable rents, with downtime of three to nine months, and is negotiating the rest. The company maintains 2026 AFFO guidance of $5.16–$5.26/share, reflecting $8M–$12M estimated rent loss. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is a tenant credit event disclosure, not a structural transaction; watch lease commencement timing and Hellweg insolvency outcome.
